answer.text: Klara arrived at the Port of Baltimore in June 1912, aged 14, aboard the SS Rhein — listed as Kowalska, Klara, bound for Green Bay, Wisconsin, where her uncle had settled. Thirteen years later she sat for this studio portrait in Green Bay.
